lane: H86N pure earthquake-field anisotropy / structural-shape follow-up
novelty_scope: New relative to executed run cards found in this checkout on 2026-10-25; not a claim of global novelty across all repositories or literature. Earlier proposals are disclosed rather than relabeled as executed results.
ranking_basis: Qualitative expected same-split HOLDOUT-DTI information gain per implementation cost, catalogue-missing specificity, mimic separability, and distance from executed lanes. No numeric DTI projection is made.

common_gates.holdout: buffered whole fault components, visible-only catalogue-derived features, pixel-exact visible mask, pooled DTI alpha=0.2 beta=0.8 triangular radius=300 m, physical-block 95% CI
common_gates.canary: single-feature discriminative AUC > 0.90 is leakage until proven otherwise
common_gates.registry: surface and final dots; Spearman <= 0.90 and forward 3-pixel overlap <= 0.70; stop on either firing
common_gates.budget: at most 3 experiments or 2 hours; no weekly slot

hypotheses.name: Pure multi-scale earthquake-lineation anisotropy
hypotheses.physical_signature: Log-intensity Hessian ridge strength and eigenvalue anisotropy at 2- and 4-pixel scales, rank-normalized and combined with multi-scale persistence; Band 10 is retained as a separate distance/closeness control rather than multiplied into the proposed lineation mechanism.
hypotheses.catalogue_missing_rationale: A blind active fault can organize earthquakes into a narrow lineation without a mapped surface trace, while a geothermal injection or volcanic swarm is more likely to be compact/radial. The anisotropy/persistence test targets the spatial shape, not merely high event density.
hypotheses.repo_distinction: No executed run card in this checkout uses Bands 10/16 as a pure primary structural surface with Hessian lineation and a distance-only control. H86C/H86F/H86I used seismicity as one component of larger multi-physics or supervised stacks; H86M-LT is tomography, not a seismicity holdout. This formalizes the deferred EQL idea while keeping it a distinct pure lane.
hypotheses.named_non_fault_mimic: Induced geothermal injection swarm or volcanic dike swarm with an elongated aftershock/cloud footprint; compactness, multi-scale anisotropy and a later non-fault review are required discriminants, not proof of a fault.
hypotheses.expected_dti_benefit: Highest qualitative priority: may add catalogue-missing linear corridors in geophysically bland cover and is aligned with the 300 m metric scale after thinning. No numeric gain is projected; only a like-for-like HOLDOUT-DTI with CI can establish benefit.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Low to medium: native-band read, Gaussian/Hessian transforms, one canary per feature, shared holdout evaluation, and shared registry/writer gates.
hypotheses.data_availability: Native 19-band TIFF is restored and its SHA-256 is pinned; the required shared cached feature stack is absent, so this is not executable/validated in the current state. No external data are required for the first test.

hypotheses.name: Cross-depth conductance–seismicity phase offset
hypotheses.physical_signature: Measure a signed cross-strike offset, projected along the Band-15 basement-depth gradient, between a shallow conductance edge and a persistent earthquake lineation; gate by positive dilatation and compare to zero-offset and shuffled-offset controls.
hypotheses.catalogue_missing_rationale: A dipping blind hydrothermal conduit may place microseismicity deeper/up-dip from a shallow clay/conductance cap, leaving no mapped scarp. The phase relation, rather than either raw layer, is the target.
hypotheses.repo_distinction: No executed card implements a fold-visible, signed offset statistic between these layers. It is not the H86M-CNT conductivity-neck product (already executed) and not a raw conductance covariate; it tests directed phase geometry.
hypotheses.named_non_fault_mimic: Flat-lying playa brine or smectite sheet whose conductance edge and catalogue density are unrelated but coarsely aligned by basin geometry.
hypotheses.expected_dti_benefit: Medium qualitative potential as a complementary blind-conduit signal if the phase sign is stable across quadrants; a broad 100-km catalogue smoothing may cap precision.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium: signed distance/warp transforms, phase controls, and fold-safe visible-catalogue recomputation.
hypotheses.data_availability: All first-test layers exist in the restored native band map; actual shared cache is missing. Official USGS conductance/GDR context is recorded but not needed for the native first test.

hypotheses.name: Potential-field step-versus-compact-source shape likelihood
layers: training_features.tif Bands 5 iso_grav_anom_slope, 11 iso_grav_anom_vg, and 18 iso_grav_anom_hg
hypotheses.physical_signature: At frozen scales, fit a local odd-symmetric step template and an even-symmetric compact/dike template to gravity and magnetic profiles; retain coherent step likelihood only where signed derivative orientation agrees across the two fields. Band 11 and Band 18 retain the verified directional semantics in src/gems86/io.py.
hypotheses.catalogue_missing_rationale: A buried fault step should produce a polarity-changing/extended response, while dikes, pluton contacts and compact bodies can produce strong but symmetric ridges that attract generic edge detectors. Rejecting the compact-source shape may favor concealed discontinuities.
hypotheses.repo_distinction: No executed lane in this checkout fits competing step/compact response shapes. H86F-GZZD/H86H-PSTD use derivative/tensor features and H86J-MPC uses monogenic phase; this is an explicit source-shape likelihood with polarity controls, not another gradient rank.
hypotheses.named_non_fault_mimic: Mafic dike swarm, elongated intrusive contact, or overlapping compact sources that form an apparently linear potential-field edge.
hypotheses.expected_dti_benefit: Medium-low qualitative potential: shape rejection is physically targeted but sensitive to source depth, filtering and the local sign convention; improvement must be shown against raw-edge and compact-source controls.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium: profile sampling, scale calibration, signed-band QA, and ablation controls.
hypotheses.data_availability: Native bands are restored; shared cache remains the blocker. No external bytes required for a first experiment.

hypotheses.name: Broad low-relief warp persistence
hypotheses.physical_signature: Signed profile-curvature and low-order polynomial warp residuals at several 300–1200 m smoothing scales, retaining sign-stable broad flexure across orientations and rejecting only sharp single-scale scarps.
hypotheses.catalogue_missing_rationale: An old or degraded fault-related warp can survive erosion or alluvial burial after its sharp scarp disappears. Existing catalogue-following scarp detectors preferentially learn exposed, sharp faults; a persistent broad warp targets a different expression.
hypotheses.repo_distinction: This is not the executed LiDAR scarp, slope threshold, sharp curvature, or vent-flexure lanes: it is a sign-stable broad-wavelength warp with no catalogue distance or external 1 m LiDAR. The distinction is testable by a broad-only ablation.
hypotheses.named_non_fault_mimic: Pleistocene lake-shoreline benches, differential compaction, alluvial fan tilting, or a broad volcanic-edifice flank.
hypotheses.expected_dti_benefit: Low to medium qualitative potential in the 24.63% non-LiDAR/low-relief gap; broad support may underperform the 300 m metric unless emission is carefully thinned.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Low to medium: native filters and a scale-persistence control, but the holdout canary and edge handling remain mandatory.
hypotheses.data_availability: Native bands are restored; shared cache absent. No external data required for the first test.

hypotheses.name: Independent alteration-mineral boundary corroboration
layers: External official USGS ASTER/SWIR mineral-index release would be required and must be acquired/hash-pinned on an unrestricted workstation
training_features.tif Bands 2 rtp, 13 iso_grav_anom, and 17 cond_surf as native structural context
hypotheses.physical_signature: Linear, low-relief Al-OH and hydrated-silica absorption-index boundaries co-located with magnetic quieting and conductance edges, targeting vapor-zone alteration above blind fluid pathways.
hypotheses.catalogue_missing_rationale: A blind geothermal structure can lack a mapped scarp but leave shallow alteration; an independent mineral index could add evidence unavailable in the current 19-band stack.
hypotheses.repo_distinction: No executed lane in this checkout uses SWIR mineral absorption indices. It is not a relabeling of GeoDAWN K/Th/U radiometric ratios, which are nuclear-count proxies rather than vibrational mineral spectra.
hypotheses.named_non_fault_mimic: Detrital clay-rich alluvium derived from altered volcanic tuff or mine-related alteration.
hypotheses.expected_dti_benefit: Potentially high geological complementarity but unknown; no numeric projection is allowed before a pinned source and blind holdout.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: High: external acquisition, licensing/provenance check, 100 m EPSG:32611 co-registration, and coverage/edge QA.
hypotheses.data_availability: Not available in this sandbox and not in the shared cache. Explicitly deferred; no external source is silently substituted.
